The record is mixed on diplomacy, but the stronger evidence points to militarized state power, fear-inducing detention practices, executions, and repression of critics.","evidence":[{"title":"DRC President Felix Tshisekedi must be held accountable for human rights violations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/news/2024/09/drc-president-felix-tshisekedi-must-be-held-accountable-for-human-rights-violations/","summary":"Amnesty says the ongoing State of Siege in North Kivu and Ituri militarized everyday life, concentrated power in military and police officials, and was used alongside a crackdown on dissent under the pretext of defending the country against enemies. This is the clearest evidence that fear was being managed through coercive state power rather than reduced in a rights-respecting way.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4"]},{"title":"2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Democratic Republic of the Congo","publisher":"U.S. Department of State via ECOI","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128488.html","summary":"The report says security services used unofficial detention facilities and did not reliably observe arrest, detention, and due-process rules. That supports a broader political fear climate rather than reduced insecurity.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4"]},{"title":"Congo lifts moratorium on death penalty, justice ministry circular shows","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-15","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/congo-lifts-moratorium-death-penalty-153836346.html","summary":"Reuters reports the move was framed as a way to rid the army of traitors and curb terrorism and banditry. That is evidence of using punitive force and fear-based discipline as a governing tool, not merely reducing insecurity.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"DRC: Authorities must immediately free detained journalist","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/drc-authorities-must-immediately-free-detained-journalist/","summary":"Amnesty says journalist Stanis Bujakera’s continued detention was judicial harassment meant to chill criticism. That is direct evidence of a political fear climate, especially for journalists.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4","3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"DR Congo’s arrest of activists invokes déjà vu of growing repression","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-16","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/dr-congos-arrest-of-activists-invokes-deja-vu-of-growing-repression/","summary":"Amnesty says LUCHA activists were taken by security agents into unknown detention and subjected to violence and threats. This supports a finding that domestic insecurity was being handled through intimidation of civil society rather than reduced.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4","3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: Democratic Republic of Congo","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/democratic-republic-congo","summary":"HRW says repression against journalists, activists, critics, and opposition members continued while government forces killed civilians during enforcement operations. That is strong evidence that the state was not simply lowering fear, but helping sustain it.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.2","3B.1","3B.4"]},{"title":"More than 260 women sexually assaulted during Congo prison break, UN report shows","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-09-12","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/More-than-260-women-sexually-assaulted-during-Congo-prison-break-UN-reports-shows-47860482/","summary":"Reuters reports prison guards used live fire during the Makala escape attempt, killing at least 129 people, and that more than 260 female inmates were sexually assaulted. This is severe state violence that directly contradicts any claim that the government reduced domestic fear without coercion.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.1","3B.4","3B.5"]},{"title":"Army disarray hobbles Congo's fight with Rwanda-backed rebels, officers say","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-17","url":"https://theprint.in/world/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/2160048/","summary":"Reuters says the government relied on Wazalendo militias, had no control over them, and faced weak discipline and poor logistics. Tshisekedi reportedly told them to be brought in line, which is partial mitigating evidence, but the overall picture is of insecurity managed through unstable proxy force rather than fear reduction.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.5","3B.2","3B.4"]},{"title":"Congolese president sacks military top brass in major reshuffle","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-12-20","url":"https://theprint.in/world/congolese-president-sacks-military-top-brass-in-major-reshuffle/2411531/","summary":"Tshisekedi replaced the army chief, military intelligence head, and many senior officers. This is the strongest late-year corrective move I found, but it reads more like damage control than proof that the year produced a lower-fear climate.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Programme de désarmement et démobilisation: une alternative pour la paix et la cohésion sociale","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-03-22","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/","summary":"The government described P-DDRCS as a stabilization and cohesion program meant to restore state authority where absent. This is the clearest positive institutional signal I found, because it points to non-terrorizing stabilization rather than simple coercion.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.5","2B.7"]},{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la RDC: les présidents Félix Tshisekedi et Salva Kiir appellent au respect des accords de paix","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-03-25","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au_respect_des_accords_de_paix","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly called for the relaunch of the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability. This is positive counterevidence, but it is diplomacy rather than proof that domestic fear actually fell.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.7","2B.10"]},{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la RDC: les présidents Félix Tshisekedi et João Lourenço appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-08-12","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au_respect_du_cessez_le_feu","summary":"Tshisekedi backed the Luanda process, welcomed the ceasefire, and said his government was available for next steps. This is meaningful de-escalatory evidence, but again it does not outweigh the coercive domestic record.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.7","2B.10"]},{"title":"Readout of the Secretary-General’s meeting with Félix Tshisekedi","publisher":"United Nations","date":"2024-09-24","url":"https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/sg/readouts/2024-09-24/readout-of-the-secretary-generals-meeting-he-mr-felix-antoine-tshisekedi-tshilombo-president-of-the-democratic-republic-of-the-congo-scroll-down-for-french","summary":"The UN readout shows Tshisekedi keeping the issue in a diplomatic, peace-process frame rather than an ethnic or sectarian fear frame. This is the clearest positive evidence that he sometimes sought reduced insecurity through negotiation.","question_ids":["3B.6","2B.7","2B.10","3B.3"]}]}
